title: X-Guard: Multilingual Guard Agent for Content Moderation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating safety label classification accuracy, F1-scores, and translation metrics across 132 different languages, comparing the performance of low-resource languages and code-switching attacks (e.g., Sandwich Attacks) against English to measure linguistic disparities in content moderation.

Comparing the varying safety labels assigned by different individual judge LLMs (e.g., Llama-Guard, Qwen, Llama-3, OpenAI Moderation API) on identical synthetic text to identify model-specific evaluation biases, which is mitigated using a multi-model jury voting approach.

Analyzing the impact of 'translationese' and linguistic artifacts introduced by translation models (Google Cloud Translation and mBART-50) on the downstream safety evaluator's ability to properly assess native slang and culturally-specific harmful content.
